inputs.text: [excited] He was 6 meters long — as long as a road is wide, he took up the whole street! 2 meters tall — [quickly] as tall as a front door! And 5,000 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as an elephant! Scientists think he could run about 16 miles an hour — as fast as a bike going fast.
[confident] Yes. A real heavyweight, [proud] with a head even more impressive than his body.
